content: Paper titled "Why Industry Migrates and When It Trusts LLMs: A Practitioner Survey on LLM-Assisted Software Migration" accepted for presentation at ESEM 2026.

Paper titled "DepWareTrans: Dependency-Aware Incremental Repository Migration Across Co-Executable Languages" accepted as a full paper for presentation at the ASE Industry Showcase Track and publication in the conference proceedings.
Paper titled "LegacyWorld: Atomicity-Aware Evaluation of GUI Agents for Legacy Workflows" accepted at the ICSME Industry Track and publication in the conference proceedings.
Presented "Leveraging LLMs for Multi-File DSL Code Generation: An Industrial Case Study" at EASE 2026.
Presented at AIware'25 on Extract Method Refactoring.
Paper titled "Automated Extract Method Refactoring with Open-Source LLMs: A Comparative Study" got accepted for publication in AIware'25.
Paper published in Empirical Software Engineering journal on design pattern recognition using large language models.
Started PhD research at TUM focusing on Generative AI for code migration and modernization.
